line: I’ma break your heart, lil’ baby, don’t come this way, don’t listen to Cupid
vault_lines: I'ma break your heart, lil' baby, don't come this way, don't listen to Cupid
meaning: Kodak is warning females to not fall in love with him because he won’t love them back. In mythology, Cupid is the god of love who carries a bow and arrow. If someone is shot with his arrow, they’ll fall in love quickly.

line: I’m ballin’ like I’m James Harden, I bought a brand-new rocket
vault_lines: I'm ballin' like I'm James Harden, I bought a brand-new rocket
meaning: Reference to professional basketball player James Harden who played for the Houston Rockets from 2012 to 2021.

line: I been up all week, tryna get me a Patek Philippe
vault_lines: I been up all week, tryna get me a Patek Philippe
meaning:
Patek Philippe is a prestigious and luxury Swiss watch company founded in 1839. The watches are very expensive, so Kodak is grinding to purchase another Patek.



Kodak mentioned the popular watch brand in his 2017 song “Patty Cake”:

I’m gettin' tired of the Rollie, I think I want Patek Philippe

line: Feel like Langston Hughes, I hit the booth and spit that poetry
vault_lines: Feel like Langston Hughes, I hit the booth and spit that poetry
meaning: Langston Hughes was an American poet and social activist best known as an early innovator of jazz poetry during the Harlem Renaissance in the 1920s.
